description.value:
As an Action, you can supercharge a shot with arcane energy. As part of this action, you can expend up to 3 uses of your Arcane Shot. The projectile shoots forth in a line 1 foot wide and 150 feet long, before disappearing. The projectile passes harmlessly through objects and magical barriers like Wall of Force, ignoring cover. Each creature in that line must make a Dexterity Saving Throw against your Arcane Shot save DC. On a failed save, a creature takes 6d12 force damage + 2d12 additional force damage for every use of Arcane Shot you expended as part of this action.

You can use this feature once and you cannot use it again until you have finished a Long Rest.
